hero.tagline: At Nadin Sadr Aria I work with React and TypeScript on real products — clear screens, shared components, and the small details that matter.

about.title: I see frontend as part of building the product
about.p1: I'm Kiana, a junior frontend developer with about 1.5 years of experience. I work mostly with React and TypeScript inside a product team.
about.p2: At Nadin Sadr Aria I help ship features for Sana and Enterprise AI — from shared components and forms to everyday fixes that keep the product moving.
points: Shared components used across the product
Forms and product flows that users actually use
Small utilities and hooks that save time for the team
Fixes, polish, and bilingual support when needed

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Two products I work on at Nadin Sadr Aria.

sana.name: Sana
sana.summary: A company platform for processes and forms. I help build the parts people fill out and manage every day.
bullets: Built reusable form pieces like date and color pickers for the shared form system
Improved process and task screens so flows feel clearer and more stable
Worked on uploads, permissions, and Persian/English text across the app
Fixed bugs and cleaned up UI behavior with the team

enterpriseAi.name: Enterprise AI
enterpriseAi.summary: An AI product platform for teams. I work on product screens and shared frontend pieces that support daily use.
bullets: Helped build Studio and form features so teams can manage content more easily
Worked on chat and knowledge screens, including uploads and clearer actions
Improved access control and shared UI across different parts of the product
Added tests for some flows and fixed issues found during delivery
